description: This file defines classes and constants for managing state in Spark Structured Streaming, specifically for use with applyInPandasWithState. It includes the GroupState class for handling per-group state, and GroupStateTimeout for timeout types.

classes.name: GroupStateTimeout
classes.description: Represents the type of timeouts possible for Dataset operations applyInPandasWithState.

classes.name: GroupState
classes.description: Wrapper class for interacting with per-group state data in applyInPandasWithState.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the state value as a tuple or raises an error if not exists.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns the state value as a tuple or None if not exists.

methods.name: hasTimedOut
methods.description: Indicates if the state has timed out.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the state with a new value.

methods.name: setTimeoutDuration
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration in milliseconds for processing time timeout.

methods.name: setTimeoutTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timeout timestamp for event time timeout.

methods.name: getCurrentWatermarkMs
methods.description: Gets the current event time watermark in milliseconds.

methods.name: getCurrentProcessingTimeMs
methods.description: Gets the current processing time in milliseconds.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String representation of the GroupState object.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Serializes the internal state to JSON format.
